The **largest pharmaceutical settlement ever** was reached by **Purdue Pharma**.  
In 2020, Purdue Pharma agreed to pay a total of **$8.344 billion**—comprising $5.544 billion in criminal fines and forfeiture plus $2.8 billion in civil liabilities under the False Claims Act—making it the biggest settlement in the history of U.S. pharmaceutical litigation.  
*Source: “Top Pharmaceutical Litigation Settlements of All Time” (CPM Legal)*
